camel_example: aliyun sls POST /context-models/orders/query --region cn-hangzhou --header "Content-Type=application/json" --body '{"query":".umodel | where kind = '"'"'log_set'"'"' | limit 50"}' --name 'orders'
description_en: Queries the content of a semantic model by using SPL
description_zh: SPL 查询 Semantic Model 内容
kebab_example: aliyun sls query-context-model --name orders --query '.umodel | where kind = '"'"'log_set'"'"' | limit 50' --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryContextModel

parameters.help_en: The identifier of the context model to be queried. It is obtained from the request path /context-models/{name}/query. Only uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-) are supported
parameters.help_zh: 待查询的上下文模型标识，取自请求路径 /context-models/{name}/query，仅支持大小写字母、数字、下划线（_）与短横线（-）
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The SPL query statement. This parameter is required and cannot be an empty string. Otherwise, a 400 error is returned. It uses .umodel as the data source to query the element definitions of the model. Pipeline operations such as where, project, and limit are supported. Example: .umodel | where kind = 'log_set' | limit 50
parameters.help_zh: SPL 查询语句，必填且不可为空串，否则返回 400。以 .umodel 作为数据源查询该模型的元素定义，支持 where、project、limit 等管道操作，例如 .umodel | where kind = 'log_set' | limit 50
parameters.name: query

schema.description_en: The response body that contains the column names and data rows matched by the query
schema.description_zh: 响应体。返回本次查询命中的列名与数据行

data.description_en: The array of result rows. Each row is an array whose elements correspond one-to-one in order with the header. An empty array [] is returned if no matches are found
data.description_zh: 结果行数组，每行是与 header 按顺序一一对应的数组；无命中时返回空数组 []

items.description_en: A result row. The order of the elements corresponds one-to-one with the column names in the header
items.description_zh: 一行结果，元素顺序与 header 中的列名一一对应

items.description_en: The cell value, which is always a string. The values in the metadata, schema, and spec columns are JSON strings that the caller must parse
items.description_zh: 单元格值，恒为字符串；其中 metadata、schema、spec 三列的内容本身是 JSON 字符串，需要调用方自行解析

header.description_en: The array of column names. The columns vary based on the projection in the SPL query. If no explicit projection is specified, the default columns are kind, metadata, schema, and spec
header.description_zh: 列名数组，随 SPL 的投影而变；未显式投影时默认为 kind、metadata、schema、spec

v1_body_parameters.help_en: The request body. A JSON object that contains an SPL query for the element definitions of the model
v1_body_parameters.help_zh: 请求体。JSON 对象，携带一条针对该模型元素定义的 SPL 查询
v1_body_parameters.name: body

v1_parameters.help_en: The request body. A JSON object that contains an SPL query for the element definitions of the model
v1_parameters.help_zh: 请求体。JSON 对象，携带一条针对该模型元素定义的 SPL 查询
v1_parameters.name: body

v1_parameters.help_zh: 待查询的上下文模型标识，取自请求路径 /context-models/{name}/query，仅支持大小写字母、数字、下划线（_）与短横线（-）
